comments.snippet:
fixed in nightly `1.84.0+f7ff789c90` (https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly).

View → load layout → "Load from file..." accepted any XML file. A file that is not a panel layout closed all panels and then failed with "The XML file format is invalid.", so the window stayed empty. The file is now checked first: one that is not a panel layout is refused with a message in the Notifications panel and the current layout is kept.
